shared_elements: human or humanoid figures shown in profile
registers or bands organizing the surface
small repeated decorative/script-like signs in rows
justification: Both show profile human figures with raised arms and both include wing motifs and rows of small sign-like marks, but these are generic correspondences: A is a large-scale two-panel scene of a monumental winged lion-bird demon confronted by a muscular four-winged bearded figure with a staff, rendered with heavy naturalistic musculature and elaborately layered feathering, while B is a stele-shaped surface with a small arched lunette of slender clothed figures flanking a rayed disc above many dense horizontal lines of script. The dominant differences in figure scale, composition (two facing monumental figures vs. a tiny scene over a text block) and drawing convention outweigh the shared generic traits.
